page.title: Practice Sheets & Print Exercises (A4)
page.description: Generate standard Japanese essay sheets (Genkō Yōshi 400 grids), Kanji stroke boxes, and cross grids for pen practice.

genkouyoushi.title: 400-Grid Essay Sheet (Genkō Yōshi)
genkouyoushi.description: Standard 20 cols × 20 rows essay grid with horizontal center margins, student name block, and date lines.
genkouyoushi.f2: Supports sample essay pre-fill & faint trace

kanji_grid.title: Kanji Practice Grids
kanji_grid.description: Cross (+), diagonal asterisk (*), and plain square grids to practice Kanji and Kana stroke proportions.

pdf_print.title: Export PDF & Print A4
pdf_print.description: Integrated zero-margin print styling engine with no page overflow and zero orphan blank pages.
